user_query: I want to translate a legal document from English to Spanish. Can you fetch the supported languages for translation? Additionally, provide me with the details of my recent orders and my account information.

TaskList.description: Fetch the supported languages for translation to ensure that Spanish is available.
Retrieve user account information including preferences for document translation.
Get the details of recent orders to check if there are any relevant documents to be translated.
Translate the legal document from English to Spanish using the available translation API.
